flagged.title: Water, Aquifers and Waste
flagged.reason: The video incorrectly states that chalk has moderate porosity rather than high porosity, contradicting a key rock property examined on the GCSE geology syllabus.

mark_affecting.quote: Now chalk has moderate porosity in its primary pores, but it is highly permeable.

flagged.title: Geology and Civil Engineering
flagged.reason: The video states that strata dipping toward the reservoir causes water to seep under the dam (the old reversed claim), which directly contradicts engineering geology and would cause students to lose marks on dam siting questions.

mark_affecting.quote: If the rock strata dip toward the reservoir, water can seep right under the dam along those bedding planes.

flagged.title: Investigative Geology: Maps, Fieldwork and Practical Skills
flagged.reason: The video presents an inverted Rule of Vs both in narration and in the on-screen summary table (claiming upstream dip points downstream and vice versa), which will cause students to deduce the wrong dip direction on exam maps.

mark_affecting.quote: If the strata are dipping upstream, the V points downstream.
